status: local-government residential controls; estimated workplaces and OD
residents_meaning: Modelled working trip-makers. Working-resident weights use reported SIAK occupations where available; missing areas use the median reported participation ratio. Not total inhabitants.
jobs_meaning: Estimated workplace capacity; regional JUTPI2018 shares scaled to modelled working residents. DKI city split updated with deduplicated registered Jamsostek202406 membership. Not a current workplace census.
within_region_jobs: OSM land-use with official Bekasi Regency industrial point locations, Bekasi city company-count kecamatan proxies2025, Tangerang city large-industry kecamatan proxies2023. No per-company staffing invented.
od_model: Synthetic doubly constrained regional gravity,18km decay; local distance-weighted sampling. No observed home-work links.
driving_model: 1.35 straight-line detour,24km/h plus180s; no road routing or measured congestion.
